observed_contract: Every rebound entrypoint owns a separate SubagentLifecycle maximum_parallel semaphore.
rebind_pool_and_drain publishes the replacement before the retired generation drains.
Existing tests intentionally allow a new child to run on the replacement while an old child remains active.
risk: During auth/runtime pool refresh the configured server-wide child parallelism can multiply by the number of overlapping generations. This can overbook legitimate provider slots, amplify rate-limit pressure and make the advertised maximum_parallel no longer bound actual provider work.

candidate_contract.rule: One ServerSubagentLifecycle-wide semaphore must span all entrypoint generations.
candidate_contract.ordering: Capture and account the entrypoint before waiting for the global permit so drain still protects an old pool from queued launches that already captured it.
